summary: The prepared base already contains merged upstream PR #36143, the only current issue-specific maintainer candidate. Reporter revision d6ab04bdf157d80aff9e850535921c58adace116 used fp32_acc=False in both TRT-LLM fused all-reduce paths; the base uses FP32 accumulation for TRT-LLM and preserves the MNNVL boundary. Focused regressions and an independent gfx950 numerical mechanism check passed. The original GLM-5.3-Flash 8xH20 serving failure could not be reproduced on the assigned single gfx950, so this is not claimed as an end-to-end confirmed fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Invocation integrity only; repository test/ is not an importable package, so no tests ran. The failed invocation was retained rather than hidden.
21 focused tests on gfx950, including TRT-LLM fp32_acc forwarding, the independent MNNVL backend boundary, allreduce-only FP32 forwarding, and shape/dtype/workspace/group guards.

remaining_limitations: No zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash native FP8 weights and no 8x NVIDIA H20 SM90 TP=8/EP=8 topology were available. The original serving request, TRT-LLM CUDA collective, and repeated-! output remain unverified end to end. The tiny Llama fixture was intentionally not substituted because it cannot qualify GLM-5.3 architecture, FP8 semantics, or distributed SM90 numerics.
